set.body: Strengthen the existing dependency-free, runtime-rank scalafim-zarr kernel into an extraction-ready Scala 3 Zarr implementation covering roughly 80% of scientific read and immutable-publication workloads on JVM and Scala.js. The target contract is: Zarr v3 read/create and read-only v2 lowering; groups and explicit hierarchy navigation; regular grids; default and v2 chunk keys; common fixed-width scalar types; bytes, transpose, gzip, CRC32C, sharding, plus optional codec providers; regions, slices, strides, ordered and factored gathers; streaming chunk fragments; memory, filesystem, HTTP, and Fetch stores plus optional S3; and generic create-only writes. Ranked slices: (1) executable scalar-format algebra and shape-aware codec programs, common dtype completion, transpose, and v2 chunk keys; (2) hierarchy and v2 plus consolidated-metadata lowering into the shared descriptor; (3) streaming selection and time-by-voxel factored gathers; (4) store-independent synchronous and asynchronous create-only writing; (5) remote caching, concurrency, and external conformance; (6) NeuroArchive, BIDS, NIfTI, and standalone-extraction proof. Completion requires JVM and Scala.js tests, Zarr-Python and zarr_implementations differential fixtures, standalone consumer proof, and representative fMRI remote-access evidence. Explicitly out of scope: concurrent mutation, resize or append, variable-length types, exotic grids or storage transformers, and heavy codecs or cloud SDKs in core. zarr-java is an oracle and optional JVM escape hatch, not a core dependency.
set.title: Epic: Zarr Z8 portable Scala Zarr core for common scientific workloads
